title: The signs waiting for a text back
old_caption: Waiting for a text back: Aries ran a 5K in four minutes, Gemini drafted fourteen replies to no message, Aquarius thinks the phone is shy. Which one are you right now?

title: The signs as wedding guests
old_caption: Gemini gave two toasts nobody asked for, Virgo fixed the seating chart, and Pisces cried at the napkins. Which wedding guest are you, honestly?

title: Silent review: a homemade dinner
old_caption: Virgo, silent review: lifts the lid, measures the garnish, one slow nod. Then reads the side note, 'no onions, you said so once', and sheds a single tear. Plating, four stars. It's Virgo. What detail would get you?

title: Silent review: a handwritten love note
old_caption: Capricorn the stoic critic reviewed a handwritten note without saying a word. Eyebrow, nod, then the P.S. hit and the glasses fogged. Ten out of ten. Who would crack first?

title: Silent review: a surprise picnic for two
old_caption: Leo, a fan of grand gestures, silently reviews a tiny surprise picnic: blindfold off, one eyebrow, star-shaped sandwiches, slow nod, then a talk card and a single tear. No notes.

title: Silent review: a playlist made for them
old_caption: Sagittarius made Scorpio a playlist. Scorpio reviewed it in total silence: one eyebrow, slow nods, then track three was a recording of Scorpio's own laugh. Eleven out of ten.

title: Silent review: a voice note good-morning
old_caption: Taurus, not a morning star, gets a 7:02 AM voice note. Eyebrow up at 'good morning, sleepy.' By 'can't wait to see you' the replay count is at nine. Timing, three stars. What's your favorite good-morning?

title: Started: a blind mystery card both almost skipped
old_caption: Both of them were one inch from skipping the same no-photo card. Now it hangs framed over their couch with a plaque that says ALMOST SKIPPED, and Pisces visits it like a museum. Would you have tapped yes?

title: Started: an awkward hi… hi… hi collision
old_caption: Gemini and Cancer couldn't get through one doorway without a hi, a sidestep and a bonk. Now that's literally their secret handshake. What's your relationship's inside joke?

title: Started: burnt pancakes on date two
old_caption: How it started: Aries, stove on max, one pancake stuck to the ceiling, one black disc, Taurus says ten out of ten. How it's going: the ceiling pancake has a tag now. Crunch.
